note: Examples for voice/PROTOCOL.md, version 2. Voice (voice/crates/voice-protocol) and Rukoo (src/main/voice/) must both accept every message under valid, reject every message under invalid, compute every path under paths, and agree on negotiation and replay. Paths are written with the separators of their platform, whatever system runs the test.
